description: Source code implementing PlayHT text-to-speech services, including WebSocket and HTTP-based classes, with functions for language conversion, connection management, and TTS generation.

classes.name: PlayHTTTSService
classes.description: WebSocket-based PlayHT text-to-speech service supporting real-time streaming, with configuration options for language, speed, and voice settings.

classes.name: PlayHTHttpTTSService
classes.description: HTTP-based PlayHT text-to-speech service for non-streaming synthesis, supporting configuration of language, speed, and voice parameters.

methods.name: language_to_playht_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to PlayHT language code string.

methods.name: language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to PlayHT-specific language code.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the TTS service, establishing WebSocket connection if applicable.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the TTS service, closing WebSocket connection if applicable.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS process and disconnects WebSocket.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and starts message reception.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cleans up tasks.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Retrieves WebSocket URL and connects to PlayHT WebSocket.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and handles cleanup.

methods.name: _get_websocket_url
methods.description: Fetches WebSocket URL from PlayHT API.

methods.name: _handle_interruption
methods.description: Handles interruption frames, stops metrics, and resets request ID.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Receives and processes messages from WebSocket, handling audio data and control messages.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Generates speech audio frames from text via WebSocket API.

methods.description: Indicates support for metrics in HTTP TTS service.
